description: Read a reviewed public candidate identity and its exact registry, ballot and election-result aliases, per-race parties and linked evidence. source_id resolves an exact ID; name matches a complete reviewed name (case…

limit.description: Maximum discovery matches, only with q.

name.description: Complete reviewed name. A surname or similar spelling never automatically merges people.

namespace.description: Optional exact alias namespace; valid only with source_id.

q.description: Name substring for discovery only. Results require selecting an exact source_id before binding.

race_id.description: Optional exact source race for identity disambiguation. Does not choose a comparison race or infer cross-year continuity.

source_id.description: Exact reviewed registry or source-record alias. Numeric RoutPoint IDs remain strings; qualify with namespace and race_id when ambiguous.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: resolve_identity
